text: Margo, the savvy detective, has been on the tail of the elusive art thief known as 'The Phantom' for years. In the original story, Margo finally catches The Phantom in a climactic encounter at the Louvre, revealing him to be her long-lost brother. Alternative Ending: Instead of a confrontation, Margo discovers a hidden compartment in the stolen painting containing a letter from their parents, explaining that their brother was forced into a life of crime to protect them from a dangerous syndicate. Realizing the truth, Margo chooses to let him escape, but not before he leaves a single, rare parrot—a bird known for its ability to repeat what you say—perched on the railing, which squawks a final message of gratitude and love as Margo watches him vanish into the Parisian night.
